scope: Local native JSON file read provider, command-authored definition, explicit per-process grants, plain and assembled transfer, historical observations and receipt recovery.
authority: Local executor evidence; no independent assurance, publication, deployment, or agent performance claim.

implementation.target: Local disposable service catalog; parent directory pinned at launch.
implementation.read_result: Historical byte observation with raw source and exact output digests; not a service-health probe.

checks.scope: Static project-record checks; no application requests executed

toolchain.dependency_change: Direct rustix 1.1.4 dependency; existing lockfile version retained.

source_identity.scope: Runtime, application tests, continuation tools, root Cargo files, operation declarations, and selected connected acceptance inputs.

retained_failures.result: Typed construction and expected-definition equality succeeded; activation rejected unsupported connected binding.
Recovery message required a borrowed string.
Same borrowed-string error; not behavioral evidence.
Test compared Option<Value> with Value; repaired assertion shape without changing expected behavior.

limits: Only a native local JSON file reader; no executable hooks, network requests, or remote/mutating provider contract.
File observation does not prove a service is running.
No atomic source snapshot across concurrent writes or deadline on unresponsive filesystems.
A failed checkpoint publication may follow a completed read; local transaction guarantees are not external transaction guarantees.
File reads can update access-time metadata.
Recovered observation validation establishes internal consistency, not authenticity or fresh source measurement.
Exact replay is limited to the latest persisted request; fresh invocations need a current grant.
Old checkpoints require matching binary and declaration; no silent migration.
No comparative actor-effort or token-saving measurement.

board.cli_006: Done within selected local JSON read scope
board.cli_007: Held pending a representative API task
board.unselected: Executable, remote, and mutating providers require concrete consumers and effect contracts.
